name: GetTextBoxText
label: Get Text from Text Box
description: Reads and returns the text from a text box or editable field in a window using the UI element you provide.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI Element for the text box or editable field you want to read.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: TextBoxContent
fields.label: Text Box Content
fields.description: The text found in the text box or editable field.
